summary: feat(shared): prune session tokens in code instead of a Lua script
description:
Because:

- A team admin asked for a more descriptive name for the session token prune flag.

This commit:

- Renames the flag watchPrune to pruneSessionTokensServerSide.
- Renames the env var to SESSION_TOKENS_PRUNE_SERVER_SIDE; the default stays true.
- Updates the config type, the auth db check, comments and specs.

Closes FXA-14945
